constraints: This stage only evaluates review_high_priority candidates for promotion; it never removes a candidate or forces one Picked result per patient.
Reads remain per-test evidence and are never summed across DNA, RNA, or technical repeats.
DNA/RNA agreement or repeated sequencing is one analytical reproducibility axis, not independent clinical confirmation.

A bacterial high-priority candidate cannot become Picked from analytical reproducibility alone; it requires exact Level 1 or 2 hospital support in addition to compatible specimen and analytical credibility.

Direct hospital support used for promotion must contain a positive source observation with collection time or, when collection time is missing, report time within plus or minus 48 hours of the index mNGS event. Unknown timing remains high priority and is not treated as negative.

A broad host-risk flag cannot promote PJP. The host route requires a verified high-risk assertion or a production-verified high-confidence immunocompromised phenotype; provisional phenotype links and unverified medication mentions remain context only.
History evidence consumed by the route stage is provenance only here and cannot be reused as an independent host-support axis for Picked promotion.
The Candida route assesses invasive Candida infection, not Candida pneumonia.
Exact-species positive blood, sterile-site, or tissue evidence within plus or minus 48 hours of the index mNGS event may promote that species.
Missing evidence, missing detail, or missing timing is not treated as negative and never removes or demotes a candidate.
Respiratory Candida evidence alone remains high priority or context and is not promoted by the invasive Candida route.
A generic Candida or yeast label may represent an invasive event only when no event-aligned exact species is available; otherwise it remains supporting group evidence.
Beta-D-glucan is recorded as context only and is not used by this promotion policy.
Imaging is not required by the invasive Candida route and is never microbiological confirmation.
Phenotype, treatment response, WBC, CRP, and outcome do not change deterministic Picked status in this policy.
A candidate promoted from high priority is reported as a possible concurrent pathogen. It remains in picked_shadow but is not forced to be the single primary pathogen.
The policy is answer blind; benchmark answers are used only after output generation by a separate evaluator.
